data.description:
## Goal
Define core phenomenological type enums.

## Interface Contract
```python
class Valence(Enum):
    ECSTATIC = 1.0
    PLEASANT = 0.5
    NEUTRAL = 0.0
    UNPLEASANT = -0.5
    AGONIZING = -1.0

class AttentionLevel(Enum):
    BACKGROUND = 0.0
    PERIPHERAL = 0.25
    FOCUSED = 0.5
    ABSORBED = 0.75
    HYPERFOCUSED = 1.0
```

## Location
New file: cortical/reasoning/phenomenology.py

## Test Requirements
- test_valence_enum_values()
- test_attention_level_ordering()
data.title: Add Valence and AttentionLevel enums
